name: xiaoyaoclaw-usage-report
description: OpenClaw usage & performance reporting. Parse session JSONL to answer how long each agent task took, which tools/skills/models were used, and how many tokens were consumed — zero dependency, local only, token is the primary metric. The script reads, computes and outputs no cost fields at all (documentation, report and JSON follow the same scope). Output is minimized to aggregated statistics: no conversation content and no session identifiers; session-level detail (session IDs / timestamps) is opt-in via --include-sessions. Runtime makes no network calls; doc links are human-readable references only. Language: report text defaults to Chinese and can be adapted to the user's language; the skill imposes no language or region restriction. 中文：OpenClaw 用量报告——解析 session JSONL，回答每次 agent 任务耗时、所用工具/技能/模型、token 消耗。零依赖纯本地，token 为主指标，不做成本估算（不读取、不计算、不输出任何 cost 字段）。输出最小化：默认只输出聚合统计，不含会话内容原文与 session 标识（session 级明细需显式开关）；运行时不联网。

read: OpenClaw state directory: agents/*/sessions/*.jsonl (session event logs) — read-only, aggregated statistics only
environment: OPENCLAW_STATE (optional; used only to locate the state directory when --state is not given)
permissions.notes: Read-only: no file is created, modified or deleted. Data directory resolution order = --state argument -> OPENCLAW_STATE env var -> desktop build default path; the directory actually used is printed at the top of every report. Output minimization: aggregated statistics only by default (no conversation content, no session IDs); --include-sessions explicitly adds session-level identifiers/timestamps, which are sensitive operational metadata and must not be shared publicly. No cost reading/computation/output. No network access, no credentials, no configuration files read or written.
